evidence: Additive after 0079: no table, column or applied migration is removed or rewritten; the code at the W01 release (with the publication switch) keeps working on the new schema. 0080 replaces the OCR BEFORE INSERT guards ocr.validate_patient_confirmation and ocr.validate_validation_insert with the same signature, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path, volatility, error codes and messages; they now refuse a missing job, source patient, extraction, account or membership, compare with IS DISTINCT FROM, and bind the confirming account and membership to the session (the OCR API always writes the session's own). 0081 adds the insert policy ocr_outbox_staff_insert on ocr.outbox_events, bound to the session's facility and to a job of that facility the session can see; its missing policy made every OCR patient confirmation and publication fail with 42501. OCR publication stays paused by the switch the W01 release shipped (OCR_PUBLICATION_ENABLED, default false), so neither the previous nor the new ocr-api publishes once confirmations commit. 0082 adds the aggregate-only ocr.worker_queue_metrics(), owned like ocr.claim_worker_job, executable only by hid_ocr_worker (granted in the migration when the role exists). runtime-grants.sql adds the same grant and the revoke from public for a later role bootstrap; the release does not apply it. Built 0001-0082 on PostgreSQL 16 in production order (0001-0072, role bootstrap, then 0073-0082) and in new-installation order (0001-0082, then role bootstrap); every suite in services/ehr-api/database/tests and services/ehr-api/test/database passes, the three new suites fail at 0079 and pass at 0082. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence.
